column1: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir in chives and cheese.
Grate frozen butter into the dry ingredients and cut in until pea-sized crumbs form. Chill while you prep the wet ingredients.
Whisk 2/3 cup buttermilk with the egg yolk (save the white). Pour over the flour mixture, add ham, and mix until the dough clumps together.
Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch disc, and cut into 8 wedges.
Whisk 1 Tbsp buttermilk with the egg white, brush onto scones, and sprinkle with flaky salt if using.
Refrigerate scones for at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°F (204°C).
Arrange scones 2–3 inches apart on a lined baking sheet.
Bake 22–25 minutes until golden brown. Cool a few minutes before serving.
